metadata.description: Open-source tooling for building and maintaining Claude Code plugins and skills.

plugins.name: 100xeval
plugins.description: Behavioral and static evaluation for Claude Code plugins: run a plugin against saved testcases, grade whether it queried the right data and presented it correctly, plus a run-free design-quality score.

plugins.name: 100xcontinuity
plugins.description: Session continuity for Claude Code: save artifacts and conversation records from a session into a durable store, and load them back by name in a later session. Local directory (including one a sync client watches) or an S3-compatible bucket.

plugins.name: 100xdrift-check
plugins.description: Drift review for a repo holding several plugins: when a PR edits a watched plugin file, find the sibling copies in the repo's other plugins and report which siblings the change likely applies to. Non-blocking, report-only.
